# 01. DATA CLEANING

## 01.1 Overdose deaths (CDC VSRR, 12 months ending December)

```{r 01-1-deaths}
################################################################################
# 01.1 Overdose deaths (CDC VSRR, 12 months ending December)
################################################################################

# Read raw VSRR file (data.cdc.gov xkb8-kh2a)
deaths_raw <- read_csv(
  "raw/cdc_vsrr_xkb8-kh2a_raw.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
)
print(nrow(deaths_raw))

# Keep December 12-month-ending values, 2018 onward, 50 states + DC
# New York City (YC) is reported separately from the rest of New York (NY)
deaths_long <- deaths_raw %>%
  filter(
    month == "December",
    period == "12 month-ending",
    as.integer(year) >= 2018,
    !state %in% c("US", "PR")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    state = if_else(state == "YC", "NY", state),
    year = as.integer(year),
    data_value = as.numeric(data_value),
    predicted_value = as.numeric(predicted_value),
    percent_complete = as.numeric(percent_complete),
    percent_pending = as.numeric(percent_pending_investigation),
    outcome = case_when(
      indicator == "Number of Drug Overdose Deaths" ~ "deaths_all",
      indicator == "Opioids (T40.0-T40.4,T40.6)" ~ "deaths_opioid",
      indicator == "Synthetic opioids, excl. methadone (T40.4)" ~ "deaths_synthetic",
      indicator == "Psychostimulants with abuse potential (T43.6)" ~ "deaths_stimulant",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(outcome))

# Sum NY + NYC; a state-year stays missing if any part is missing
deaths_state_year <- deaths_long %>%
  group_by(state, year, outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    value = if_else(any(is.na(data_value)), NA_real_, sum(data_value)),
    predicted = if_else(any(is.na(predicted_value)), NA_real_, sum(predicted_value)),
    percent_complete = min(percent_complete),
    percent_pending = max(percent_pending),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Wide: one row per state-year
deaths_wide <- deaths_state_year %>%
  select(state, year, outcome, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = value)

deaths_pred_wide <- deaths_state_year %>%
  filter(outcome == "deaths_all") %>%
  select(state, year, deaths_all_predicted = predicted, percent_complete, percent_pending)

deaths_wide <- deaths_wide %>%
  left_join(deaths_pred_wide, by = c("state", "year"))

print(nrow(deaths_wide))
print(table(deaths_wide$year))

# Reporting log: state-years with missing values or incomplete reporting
deaths_reporting_log <- deaths_state_year %>%
  filter(is.na(value) | percent_complete < 100) %>%
  mutate(issue = case_when(
    is.na(value) ~ "value suppressed (low data quality)",
    percent_complete < 100 ~ "percent_complete < 100",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  select(state, year, outcome, issue, percent_complete)

print(deaths_reporting_log, n = 200)
print(table(deaths_reporting_log$outcome, deaths_reporting_log$year))
```

## 01.2 Population (Census state estimates)

```{r 01-2-population}
################################################################################
# 01.2 Population (Census state estimates)
################################################################################

# Vintage 2020 file for 2018-2019, Vintage 2025 file for 2020-2025
pop_2010s <- read_csv("raw/census_nst_est2020_alldata.csv") %>%
  filter(SUMLEV == "040") %>%
  select(state_name = NAME, POPESTIMATE2018, POPESTIMATE2019)

pop_2020s <- read_csv("raw/census_nst_est2025_alldata.csv") %>%
  filter(SUMLEV == "040") %>%
  select(state_name = NAME, POPESTIMATE2020:POPESTIMATE2025)

state_lookup <- tibble(
  state_name = c(state.name, "District of Columbia"),
  state = c(state.abb, "DC")
)

population <- pop_2010s %>%
  full_join(pop_2020s, by = "state_name") %>%
  pivot_longer(-state_name, names_to = "year", values_to = "population") %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_sub(year, -4))) %>%
  inner_join(state_lookup, by = "state_name") %>%
  select(state, year, population)

print(nrow(population))
print(table(population$year))
```

## 01.3 Unemployment (FRED, annual mean of monthly rate)

```{r 01-3-unemployment}
################################################################################
# 01.3 Unemployment (FRED, annual mean of monthly rate)
################################################################################

# Read the 51 monthly series (one file per state, e.g. CAUR.csv)
unemployment_files <- list.files("raw/fred_unemployment", full.names = TRUE)
print(length(unemployment_files))

unemployment_monthly <- read_csv(
  unemployment_files,
  id = "file",
  col_names = c("date", "rate"),
  col_types = "Dd",
  skip = 1
) %>%
  mutate(state = str_remove(basename(file), "UR\\.csv$"))

unemployment <- unemployment_monthly %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2025) %>%
  group_by(state, year) %>%
  summarise(unemployment_rate = mean(rate), .groups = "drop")

print(nrow(unemployment))
```

## 01.4 CMS Performance Indicator data: enrollment and expansion flag

```{r 01-4-pi}
################################################################################
# 01.4 CMS Performance Indicator data: enrollment and expansion flag
################################################################################

# Read raw PI dataset (October 2026 release)
pi_raw <- read_csv("raw/cms_pi_enrollment_raw.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
print(nrow(pi_raw))

# One row per state-month: prefer updated (U) over preliminary (P)
# Zeros reported with "Unable to provide data" are set to missing
pi_clean <- pi_raw %>%
  transmute(
    state = state_abbreviation,
    month = reporting_period,
    report_type = preliminary_or_updated,
    expanded = state_expanded_medicaid,
    total_enrollment = as.numeric(total_medicaid_and_chip_enrollment),
    child_enrollment = as.numeric(medicaid_and_chip_child_enrollment),
    adult_enrollment_reported = as.numeric(total_adult_medicaid_enrollment)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_enrollment = na_if(total_enrollment, 0),
    child_enrollment = na_if(child_enrollment, 0),
    report_rank = if_else(report_type == "U", 1, 2)
  ) %>%
  group_by(state, month) %>%
  arrange(report_rank) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(adult_enrollment = total_enrollment - child_enrollment)

print(nrow(pi_clean))

# Check derived vs CMS-reported adult enrollment where both exist
pi_adult_check <- pi_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(adult_enrollment_reported), adult_enrollment_reported > 0, !is.na(adult_enrollment))
print(nrow(pi_adult_check))
print(cor(pi_adult_check$adult_enrollment, pi_adult_check$adult_enrollment_reported))
print(summary(pi_adult_check$adult_enrollment / pi_adult_check$adult_enrollment_reported))

# Medicaid expansion: share of months in each year with expansion in effect
expansion <- pi_clean %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(str_sub(month, 1, 4))) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2025) %>%
  group_by(state, year) %>%
  summarise(expansion_share = mean(expanded == "Y"), .groups = "drop")

expansion_date <- pi_clean %>%
  filter(expanded == "Y") %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(expansion_first_month = min(month), .groups = "drop")

print(expansion_date, n = 60)
```

## 01.5 Exposure: adult enrollment change from March 2023

```{r 01-5-exposure}
################################################################################
# 01.5 Exposure: adult enrollment change from March 2023
################################################################################

# Nearest earlier valid month for each target month (handles missing months)
exposure_months <- pi_clean %>%
  filter(month >= "202301", month <= "202412") %>%
  select(state, month, adult_enrollment, total_enrollment)

exposure_baseline <- exposure_months %>%
  filter(month == "202303") %>%
  select(state, adult_mar23 = adult_enrollment, total_mar23 = total_enrollment)

exposure_dec23 <- exposure_months %>%
  filter(month <= "202312", !is.na(total_enrollment)) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  filter(month == max(month)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(state, month_dec23 = month, adult_dec23 = adult_enrollment, total_dec23 = total_enrollment)

exposure_jun24 <- exposure_months %>%
  filter(month <= "202406", !is.na(total_enrollment)) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  filter(month == max(month)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(state, month_jun24 = month, adult_jun24 = adult_enrollment, total_jun24 = total_enrollment)

exposure_dec24 <- exposure_months %>%
  filter(month <= "202412", !is.na(total_enrollment)) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  filter(month == max(month)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(state, month_dec24 = month, adult_dec24 = adult_enrollment, total_dec24 = total_enrollment)

# Percent change; fall back to total enrollment if adult baseline is missing
exposure <- exposure_baseline %>%
  left_join(exposure_dec23, by = "state") %>%
  left_join(exposure_jun24, by = "state") %>%
  left_join(exposure_dec24, by = "state") %>%
  mutate(
    exposure_source = if_else(is.na(adult_mar23) | is.na(adult_jun24), "total enrollment (adult missing)", "adult enrollment"),
    total_pct_change_jun24 = (total_jun24 / total_mar23 - 1) * 100,
    adult_pct_change_dec23 = if_else(exposure_source == "adult enrollment", (adult_dec23 / adult_mar23 - 1) * 100, (total_dec23 / total_mar23 - 1) * 100),
    adult_pct_change_jun24 = if_else(exposure_source == "adult enrollment", (adult_jun24 / adult_mar23 - 1) * 100, total_pct_change_jun24),
    adult_pct_change_dec24 = if_else(exposure_source == "adult enrollment", (adult_dec24 / adult_mar23 - 1) * 100, (total_dec24 / total_mar23 - 1) * 100),
    drop_dec23 = -adult_pct_change_dec23,
    drop_jun24 = -adult_pct_change_jun24,
    drop_dec24 = -adult_pct_change_dec24,
    drop_total_jun24 = -total_pct_change_jun24
  ) %>%
  filter(state %in% state_lookup$state)

# Standardize (main exposure = June 2024)
exposure <- exposure %>%
  mutate(
    intensity_z = (drop_jun24 - mean(drop_jun24)) / sd(drop_jun24),
    intensity_dec23_z = (drop_dec23 - mean(drop_dec23)) / sd(drop_dec23),
    intensity_dec24_z = (drop_dec24 - mean(drop_dec24)) / sd(drop_dec24),
    intensity_total_z = (drop_total_jun24 - mean(drop_total_jun24)) / sd(drop_total_jun24),
    intensity_quartile = ntile(drop_jun24, 4)
  )

print(nrow(exposure))
print(table(exposure$exposure_source))
print(exposure %>% filter(month_dec23 != "202312" | month_jun24 != "202406" | month_dec24 != "202412") %>% select(state, month_dec23, month_jun24, month_dec24))
print(summary(exposure$drop_jun24))
print(sd(exposure$drop_jun24))
print(exposure %>% arrange(desc(drop_jun24)) %>% select(state, drop_dec23, drop_jun24, drop_dec24, exposure_source), n = 60)
print(cor(exposure %>% select(drop_dec23, drop_jun24, drop_dec24, drop_total_jun24)))
```

## 01.6 Renewal outcomes: procedural share, ex parte share, start month

```{r 01-6-renewals}
################################################################################
# 01.6 Renewal outcomes: procedural share, ex parte share, start month
################################################################################

# Read raw CAA reporting metrics (reporting months March 2023 - July 2024)
caa_raw <- read_csv("raw/cms_caa_reporting_metrics_raw.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
print(nrow(caa_raw))

caa <- caa_raw %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.numeric(value),
    metric = case_when(
      str_detect(metric_name, "^Total number of beneficiaries due for renewal in the reporting month \\(Metric 5\\)") ~ "due",
      str_detect(metric_name, "\\(Metric 5a1\\)") ~ "renewed_ex_parte",
      str_detect(metric_name, "^Total beneficiaries determined ineligible.*\\(Metric 5b\\)") ~ "terminated_ineligible",
      str_detect(metric_name, "^Total beneficiaries whose coverage was terminated.*\\(Metric 5c\\)") ~ "terminated_procedural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(metric)) %>%
  select(state, month = reporting_period, metric, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value)

print(nrow(caa))

renewals <- caa %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    due_total = sum(due, na.rm = TRUE),
    terminated_procedural_total = sum(terminated_procedural, na.rm = TRUE),
    terminated_ineligible_total = sum(terminated_ineligible, na.rm = TRUE),
    renewed_ex_parte_total = sum(renewed_ex_parte, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_termination_month = min(month[(terminated_procedural + terminated_ineligible) > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    procedural_share = terminated_procedural_total / (terminated_procedural_total + terminated_ineligible_total),
    ex_parte_share = renewed_ex_parte_total / due_total,
    delayed_unwinding = as.integer(first_termination_month > "202306"),
    heavy_ex_parte = as.integer(ex_parte_share >= quantile(ex_parte_share, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  filter(state %in% state_lookup$state)

print(nrow(renewals))
print(summary(renewals$procedural_share))
print(summary(renewals$ex_parte_share))
print(table(renewals$first_termination_month))
print(renewals %>% filter(delayed_unwinding == 1 | heavy_ex_parte == 1) %>% select(state, first_termination_month, ex_parte_share, delayed_unwinding, heavy_ex_parte), n = 60)
```

## 01.7 Medicaid buprenorphine prescriptions (SDUD)

```{r 01-7-sdud}
################################################################################
# 01.7 Medicaid buprenorphine prescriptions (SDUD)
################################################################################

# FDA NDC directory extract (buprenorphine products, current + excluded files)
fda_ndc <- read_csv("raw/fda_buprenorphine_ndc_raw.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
  separate(ndc_package_code, into = c("ndc_labeler", "ndc_product", "ndc_package"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    ndc = paste0(str_pad(ndc_labeler, 5, "left", "0"), str_pad(ndc_product, 4, "left", "0"), str_pad(ndc_package, 2, "left", "0")),
    name_all = toupper(paste(proprietary_name, nonproprietary_name, substance)),
    route = toupper(replace_na(route, "")),
    formulation = case_when(
      str_detect(route, "TRANSDERMAL") | str_detect(name_all, "BUTRANS|TRANSDERMAL") ~ "pain",
      str_detect(name_all, "BELBUCA") ~ "pain",
      route == "BUCCAL" & !str_detect(name_all, "NALOXONE") ~ "pain",
      str_detect(route, "INTRAMUSCULAR|INTRAVENOUS") | str_detect(name_all, "BUPRENEX") ~ "pain",
      str_detect(route, "SUBLINGUAL|SUBCUTANEOUS") ~ "oud",
      str_detect(name_all, "NALOXONE|SUBOXONE|SUBUTEX|ZUBSOLV|BUNAVAIL|SUBLOCADE|BRIXADI") ~ "oud",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    fda_source_rank = if_else(source == "current", 1, 2)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ndc) %>%
  arrange(fda_source_rank) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ndc, fda_name = proprietary_name, fda_route = route, fda_formulation = formulation)

print(nrow(fda_ndc))
print(table(fda_ndc$fda_formulation))

# Read raw SDUD buprenorphine extract
sdud_raw <- read_csv("raw/sdud_buprenorphine_2018_2025_raw.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
print(nrow(sdud_raw))

# Drop the national row (XX) and duplicates; classify each NDC
sdud <- sdud_raw %>%
  filter(state != "XX") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    ndc = str_pad(ndc, 11, "left", "0"),
    year = as.integer(year),
    quarter = as.integer(quarter),
    suppressed = suppression_used == "true",
    prescriptions = as.numeric(number_of_prescriptions)
  ) %>%
  left_join(fda_ndc, by = "ndc") %>%
  mutate(
    formulation = case_when(
      !is.na(fda_formulation) & fda_formulation != "unknown" ~ fda_formulation,
      str_detect(product_name, "^(SUBOX|SUBUT|ZUBSO|BUNAV|SUBLO|BRIXA)") ~ "oud",
      str_detect(product_name, "BUPRENEX|BUTRANS|BELBUCA") ~ "pain",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

print(nrow(sdud))
print(table(sdud$formulation, useNA = "ifany"))
print(sdud %>% group_by(formulation) %>% summarise(rx = sum(prescriptions, na.rm = TRUE), rows = n()))
print(sdud %>% filter(formulation == "unknown") %>% count(product_name, sort = TRUE))

# State-quarter totals of OUD buprenorphine; suppressed cells counted as 0
bup_state_quarter <- sdud %>%
  filter(formulation == "oud", state %in% state_lookup$state) %>%
  group_by(state, year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    bup_rx = sum(prescriptions, na.rm = TRUE),
    bup_rx_suppressed_rows = sum(suppressed),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(bup_rx_upper = bup_rx + 10 * bup_rx_suppressed_rows)

print(nrow(bup_state_quarter))
print(table(bup_state_quarter$year, bup_state_quarter$quarter))
print(sum(bup_state_quarter$bup_rx_suppressed_rows) * 10 / sum(bup_state_quarter$bup_rx))
```

## 01.8 Assemble and write clean Excel

```{r 01-8-write}
################################################################################
# 01.8 Assemble and write clean Excel
################################################################################

# State-level table (exposure + renewals + expansion date)
state_table <- exposure %>%
  left_join(renewals, by = "state") %>%
  left_join(expansion_date, by = "state")

print(nrow(state_table))

# State-year panel
state_year <- deaths_wide %>%
  inner_join(population, by = c("state", "year")) %>%
  left_join(unemployment, by = c("state", "year")) %>%
  left_join(expansion, by = c("state", "year")) %>%
  left_join(state_table %>% select(state, drop_jun24, intensity_z, intensity_dec23_z, intensity_dec24_z, intensity_total_z, intensity_quartile, delayed_unwinding, heavy_ex_parte, procedural_share), by = "state")

print(nrow(state_year))
print(table(state_year$year))

# State-quarter panel (population of the matching year)
state_quarter <- bup_state_quarter %>%
  inner_join(population, by = c("state", "year")) %>%
  left_join(state_table %>% select(state, drop_jun24, intensity_z, intensity_quartile, delayed_unwinding, heavy_ex_parte), by = "state")

print(nrow(state_quarter))

write_xlsx(
  list(
    state_year = state_year,
    state = state_table,
    state_quarter = state_quarter,
    reporting_log = deaths_reporting_log,
    ndc_lookup = fda_ndc
  ),
  "clean_data.xlsx"
)
```

# F1. FIRST STAGE: DISENROLLMENT → MEDICAID BUPRENORPHINE

## F1.1 Data preparation

```{r f1-1-prep}
################################################################################
# F1.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

f1_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "state_quarter") %>%
  filter(year >= 2019) %>%
  mutate(
    quarter_id = paste0(year, "Q", quarter),
    post = as.integer(year > 2023 | (year == 2023 & quarter >= 2))
  )

print(nrow(f1_df))
print(n_distinct(f1_df$state))
print(range(f1_df$quarter_id))
print(table(f1_df$post))
```

## F1.2 Analysis

```{r f1-2-analysis}
################################################################################
# F1.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Main first stage: intensity x post
f1_model_main <- fepois(
  bup_rx ~ intensity_z:post | state + quarter_id,
  offset = ~ log(population),
  cluster = ~ state,
  data = f1_df
)

print(summary(f1_model_main))
print(coeftable(f1_model_main)["intensity_z:post", ])
print(confint(f1_model_main)["intensity_z:post", ])
print((exp(coef(f1_model_main)["intensity_z:post"]) - 1) * 100)

# Event study by year (reference 2022)
f1_model_event <- fepois(
  bup_rx ~ i(year, intensity_z, ref = 2022) | state + quarter_id,
  offset = ~ log(population),
  cluster = ~ state,
  data = f1_df
)

print(summary(f1_model_event))
print(confint(f1_model_event))

# Pre-trend test (2019-2021 jointly zero)
print(wald(f1_model_event, keep = "2019|2020|2021"))

# Gate rule: negative and p < 0.05
f1_gate_pass <- coef(f1_model_main)["intensity_z:post"] < 0 & pvalue(f1_model_main)["intensity_z:post"] < 0.05
print(f1_gate_pass)
```

## F1.3 Robustness

```{r f1-3-robustness}
################################################################################
# F1.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# Suppressed cells at upper bound (10 prescriptions each)
f1_model_upper <- fepois(
  bup_rx_upper ~ intensity_z:post | state + quarter_id,
  offset = ~ log(population),
  cluster = ~ state,
  data = f1_df
)

print(summary(f1_model_upper))
print(coeftable(f1_model_upper)["intensity_z:post", ])
print(confint(f1_model_upper)["intensity_z:post", ])

# Without North Carolina and South Dakota (expanded during unwinding)
f1_model_no_expanders <- fepois(
  bup_rx ~ intensity_z:post | state + quarter_id,
  offset = ~ log(population),
  cluster = ~ state,
  data = f1_df %>% filter(!state %in% c("NC", "SD"))
)

print(summary(f1_model_no_expanders))
print(coeftable(f1_model_no_expanders)["intensity_z:post", ])
print(confint(f1_model_no_expanders)["intensity_z:post", ])

# Quartiles of disenrollment (reference = lowest quartile)
f1_model_quartile <- fepois(
  bup_rx ~ i(intensity_quartile, post, ref = 1) | state + quarter_id,
  offset = ~ log(population),
  cluster = ~ state,
  data = f1_df
)

print(summary(f1_model_quartile))
print(confint(f1_model_quartile))
```

# P1. POWER: MINIMUM DETECTABLE EFFECT VS PLAUSIBLE EFFECT

## P1.1 Data preparation

```{r p1-1-prep}
################################################################################
# P1.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

# Deaths, 2018-2022 only
p1_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "state_year") %>%
  filter(year <= 2022) %>%
  mutate(
    placebo_2021 = as.integer(year == 2021),
    placebo_2022 = as.integer(year == 2022),
    placebo_post = as.integer(year >= 2021)
  )

print(nrow(p1_df))
print(table(p1_df$year))

# Buprenorphine panel for the first-stage refit
p1_bup <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "state_quarter") %>%
  filter(year >= 2019) %>%
  mutate(
    quarter_id = paste0(year, "Q", quarter),
    post = as.integer(year > 2023 | (year == 2023 & quarter >= 2))
  )

print(nrow(p1_bup))

# Baseline quantities (2022)
p1_mean_deaths_2022 <- mean(p1_df$deaths_all[p1_df$year == 2022])
p1_mean_bup_rx_2022 <- p1_bup %>%
  filter(year == 2022) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(rx = sum(bup_rx)) %>%
  pull(rx) %>%
  mean()

print(p1_mean_deaths_2022)
print(p1_mean_bup_rx_2022)
```

## P1.2 Analysis

```{r p1-2-analysis}
################################################################################
# P1.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Placebo model mirroring the main model: separate fake post-year terms
p1_model_years <- fepois(
  deaths_all ~ intensity_z:placebo_2021 + intensity_z:placebo_2022 | state + year,
  offset = ~ log(population),
  cluster = ~ state,
  data = p1_df
)

print(summary(p1_model_years))

# Pooled placebo (one fake post term, 2021-2022)
p1_model_pooled <- fepois(
  deaths_all ~ intensity_z:placebo_post | state + year,
  offset = ~ log(population),
  cluster = ~ state,
  data = p1_df
)

print(summary(p1_model_pooled))

# MDE at 80% power, two-sided alpha 0.05, as % change per 1 SD of intensity
p1_z_factor <- qnorm(0.975) + qnorm(0.80)
p1_mde <- tibble(
  term = c("placebo 2021", "placebo 2022", "pooled 2021-2022"),
  se_log = c(se(p1_model_years)["intensity_z:placebo_2021"], se(p1_model_years)["intensity_z:placebo_2022"], se(p1_model_pooled)["intensity_z:placebo_post"])
) %>%
  mutate(mde_pct = (exp(p1_z_factor * se_log) - 1) * 100)

print(p1_mde)
p1_mde_gate <- min(p1_mde$mde_pct)
print(p1_mde_gate)

# First-stage refit (copied from F1.2)
p1_model_first_stage <- fepois(
  bup_rx ~ intensity_z:post | state + quarter_id,
  offset = ~ log(population),
  cluster = ~ state,
  data = p1_bup
)

print(summary(p1_model_first_stage))
print(confint(p1_model_first_stage)["intensity_z:post", ])

# Plausible effect per 1 SD of intensity
# Lost prescriptions per state-year = baseline annual Rx x proportional drop
p1_fs_pct <- 1 - exp(coef(p1_model_first_stage)["intensity_z:post"])
p1_fs_pct_ci <- 1 - exp(confint(p1_model_first_stage)["intensity_z:post", 1])
p1_lost_rx <- p1_mean_bup_rx_2022 * p1_fs_pct
p1_lost_rx_ci <- p1_mean_bup_rx_2022 * p1_fs_pct_ci

# Each prescription = 30 days of treatment (generous)
p1_lost_person_years <- p1_lost_rx * 30 / 365
p1_lost_person_years_ci <- p1_lost_rx_ci * 30 / 365

# Excess mortality off vs on buprenorphine per 1,000 person-years (Sordo 2017)
p1_excess_overdose <- (4.6 - 1.4) / 1000
p1_excess_allcause <- (9.5 - 4.3) / 1000

p1_plausible <- tibble(
  scenario = c(
    "overdose excess, point estimate",
    "all-cause excess, point estimate",
    "all-cause excess, first-stage CI bound"
  ),
  lost_rx = c(p1_lost_rx, p1_lost_rx, p1_lost_rx_ci),
  lost_person_years = c(p1_lost_person_years, p1_lost_person_years, p1_lost_person_years_ci),
  excess_per_py = c(p1_excess_overdose, p1_excess_allcause, p1_excess_allcause)
) %>%
  mutate(
    excess_deaths = lost_person_years * excess_per_py,
    plausible_pct = excess_deaths / p1_mean_deaths_2022 * 100,
    mde_pct = p1_mde_gate,
    mde_to_plausible = mde_pct / plausible_pct
  )

print(p1_plausible)

# Break-even: excess mortality per 1,000 person-years needed for plausible = MDE / 2
p1_breakeven_per_1000py <- (p1_mde_gate / 2 / 100 * p1_mean_deaths_2022) / p1_lost_person_years * 1000
print(p1_breakeven_per_1000py)

# Gate rule: stop if MDE > 2 x plausible effect (most generous scenario)
p1_gate_pass <- min(p1_plausible$mde_to_plausible) <= 2
print(p1_gate_pass)
```

# GATE DECISION

```{r gate}
################################################################################
# GATE DECISION
################################################################################

# Novelty passed (00_novelty.md); first stage and power from F1 and P1
print(f1_gate_pass)
print(p1_gate_pass)
print(if_else(f1_gate_pass & p1_gate_pass, "CONTINUE to outcome models", "STOP: gate failed, outcome models not run"))
```

  ),

)
